paragraphs: Lily has Dad's big black shoes. "They are magic shoes," says Lily. "I have cow feet!" She walks like a cow. Tom looks at her and smiles. "Now I have cat feet," says Tom. He walks like a cat. Lily puts yellow paper on her hair. "Now I am a chicken!" "What animal are you, Pip?" asks Lily. "Woof!" says Pip.

Pip looks at the shoes. He is sad. He has no shoes. Pip has brown hair and four feet. "Pip wants magic shoes, too," says Lily. "We can make shoes!" says Tom. They get some paper. Tom draws four small shoes. Lily draws red and blue on them.

Tom puts the paper shoes on Pip's feet. Pip stands up. "Look at Pip!" says Tom. "Is he a cow?" asks Lily. "No, he is a dog with magic feet!" Pip jumps and runs. Dad comes and looks at Pip. "Magic shoes for a magic dog!" says Dad. The children clap.
text.summary: Lily and Tom play animal games in Dad's big shoes. Pip is sad, so the children make paper shoes for his four feet.
